name: blog-page
title: Blog page
description: The blog index template, built only from library items: the title, the newest post large and every other post in a grid of three, each with an image, the date and category in capitals and a Funnel Display title.
use_for: A website's blog index. The posts are neutral examples: replace them in lib/pages/blog.ts or pass `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
Another brand's photo as a post image
source: Built from the library (site header, creative card, button, footer row) and the brand's type: Funnel Display titles, DM Sans excerpts, labels in capitals

import { Button } from '@/react/components/ui/Button' import { CreativeCard } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeCard' import { FooterRow } from '@/react/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/react/components/site/SiteHeader' import { blogContent, type BlogContent } from '@/lib/pages/blog' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' // The blog index from library items: the title, the newest post large (its image beside the title, the excerpt and a // button), then every other post in a grid of three, each an image, the date and category in capitals, the title in // Funnel Display and the excerpt. Titles change color on hover; nothing moves. `content` replaces the copy and the // posts (lib/pages/blog.ts). export interface BlogPageProps { content?: BlogContent className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' const TITLE = 'rounded-control transition-[color] duration-150 ease-standard hover:text-fg-soft' export function BlogPage({ content: c = blogContent, className }: BlogPageProps) { const [first, ...rest] = c.posts return (

{c.title}

{c.body}

{first && (

{`${first.date} · ${first.category}`}

{first.title}

{first.excerpt}

)}
{rest.map((p) => (

{`${p.date} · ${p.category}`}

{p.title}

{p.excerpt}

))}
) } export default BlogPage

// The blog index template's copy: neutral example posts by the team, with Acme placeholders. Replace them with real posts. Both flavors read this file.
/** An Acme placeholder creative: the advertiser, a neutral tone (1 to 4) and a headline. */
const creative = (brand: string, tone: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4, caption?: string) => (caption ? { brand, tone, caption } : { brand, tone })

const nav = [
	{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
	{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
	{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
	{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
]
const footer = {
	domain: 'spyglass.so',
	links: [
		{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
		{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
		{ label: 'About', href: '/about' },
		{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
		{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
		{ label: 'Terms', href: '/legal' },
	],
}
const header = { nav, secondary: { label: 'Sign in', href: '/sign-in' }, cta: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' } }

export const blogPosts = [
	{ href: '/blog/competitor-creative-mix', title: 'How to read a competitor’s creative mix.', excerpt: 'Count formats before you judge hooks. A week of one brand’s ads says more than its best one.', date: 'Nov 12, 2026', category: 'Research', image: creative('Acme Skin', 3) },
	{ href: '/blog/skincare-hooks', title: 'Five hooks that keep working in skincare ads.', excerpt: 'Before and after still leads. Here is what the rest of the top ads open with.', date: 'Nov 5, 2026', category: 'Hooks', image: creative('Acme Skin', 2) },
	{ href: '/blog/swipe-files', title: 'A swipe file your team will use.', excerpt: 'Boards work when each one answers a single question.', date: 'Oct 29, 2026', category: 'Boards', image: creative('Acme Studio', 4) },
	{ href: '/blog/launch-week', title: 'What a launch week looks like in the index.', excerpt: 'Acme Drinks shipped 40 creatives in seven days. We followed every one.', date: 'Oct 22, 2026', category: 'Research', image: creative('Acme Drinks', 1) },
	{ href: '/blog/ugc-or-studio', title: 'UGC or studio: what the numbers say.', excerpt: 'We sorted 1,000 Acme ads by format. The split was closer than we thought.', date: 'Oct 15, 2026', category: 'Formats', image: creative('Acme Fit', 3) },
	{ href: '/blog/briefs-from-changes', title: 'Write the brief from what changed.', excerpt: 'Start Monday with the five changes that matter, not fifty screenshots.', date: 'Oct 8, 2026', category: 'Briefs', image: creative('Acme Studio', 2) },
]

export const blogContent = {
	header: { ...header, nav: nav.map((l) => (l.href === '/blog' ? { ...l, current: true } : l)) },
	title: 'Blog.',
	body: 'What we learn from the creatives in the index.',
	read: 'Read the post',
	posts: blogPosts,
	footer,
}

export type BlogContent = typeof blogContent
export type BlogPost = (typeof blogPosts)[number]

import { html, nothing } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { blogContent, type BlogContent } from '@/lib/pages/blog' import '@/elements/components/ui/button' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-card' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // BlogPage.tsx as : the title, the newest post large and the others in a grid of three. Titles // change color on hover; nothing moves. `content` replaces the copy and the posts. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' const TITLE = 'rounded-control transition-[color] duration-150 ease-standard hover:text-fg-soft' /** * @summary The blog index template. */ export class BlogPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="blog-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy and posts (lib/pages/blog.ts by default). */ content: BlogContent = blogContent render() { const c = this.content ?? blogContent const [first, ...rest] = c.posts return html`

${c.title}

${c.body}

${first ? html`

${`${first.date} · ${first.category}`}

${first.title}

${first.excerpt}

${c.read}
` : nothing}
${rest.map((p) => html`

${`${p.date} · ${p.category}`}

${p.title}

${p.excerpt}

`)}
` } } define('blog-page', BlogPage)
